ingameEffects.label: Burning Clarity (Core Passive)
ingameEffects.description: ... Upon entering the battlefield, gain Unity, increasing CRIT Rate by 30% and DMG by 25%. ...
ingameEffects.shortDescription: Ye Shunguang's CRIT Rate increased by 30% and her DMG is increased by 25%.

ingameEffects.label: Dreambound Self (Mindscape Cinema N°1)
ingameEffects.description: Upon entering the battlefield, gains 6 Qingming Sword Force. This effect can trigger once every 180s in Investigation Zone mode. The Unity effect from Core Passive: Burning Clarity increases DMG dealt by an additional 10%, and they ignore 20% of the target's DEF.
ingameEffects.shortDescription: Ye Shunguang's DMG is further increased by 10% and her attacks ignore 20% of the target's DEF.

ingameEffects.label: Light & Shadow (Mindscape Cinema N°2)
ingameEffects.description: The max stack count of Bearer increases to 6, and Culmination can stack up to 9 times. While in the Enlightened Mind state, each point of Qingming Sword Force consumed grants 1 stack of Culmination. EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Soaring Light and Ultimate: Cleaving Heavens's DMG ignore 40% of the target's DEF.
ingameEffects.shortDescription: Ye Shunguang's DMG from EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Soaring Light and Ultimate: Cleaving Heavens ignores 40% of the target's DEF.

ingameEffects.label: Together into the Dust (Mindscape Cinema N°4)
ingameEffects.description: Upon entering the battlefield, gains 1,000 Decibels. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s. The Vulnerability bonus provided by Ether Veil: Verdict is increased to a maximum of 200%.
ingameEffects.shortDescription: This mindscape cinema does not affect Ye Shunguang's stats.

ingameEffects.label: Lantern Wish (Mindscape Cinema N°6)
ingameEffects.description: Upon entering the battlefield, gains 2 stacks of Lantern Wish. When entering the Enlightened Mind state, gains 1 stack of Lantern Wish, stacking up to 4 times. With 3 stacks of Lantern Wish, EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Return to Dust is replaced with Ultimate: Cleaving Heavens. When this Ultimate: Cleaving Heavens is activated, it consumes 3 stacks of Lantern Wish. The last hit of Enlightened Mind - Return to Dust and Ultimate: Cleaving Heavens deal 1,500% of ATK as additional Physical DMG.
ingameEffects.shortDescription: This ability is available in the Damage Calculator.

basicAttacks.name: Swiftedge (Basic Attack)
basicAttacks.description:
Press [BASIC] to activate:

Launches up to four forward slashes, dealing Physical DMG. Can be chained into /bDash Attack: Phantasm Dash//b after the 4th hit.

basicAttacks.name: Cloudstream Sword Will (Basic Attack)
basicAttacks.description:
Hold [BASIC] to activate:

Launches a flurry of blade shockwaves, dealing Physical DMG. Hold to extend the attack. Anti-Interrupt Level is increased during this skill.

basicAttacks.name: Enlightened Mind - Splitting Currents (Basic Attack)
basicAttacks.description:
While in the /bEnlightened Mind//b state and on the ground, press [BASIC] to activate:

Performs up to three forward slashes, dealing Physical DMG. If struck by an enemy attack during the 3rd hit, triggers a block, negating that instance of DMG. If she possesses /bQingming Sword Force//b, the 3rd hit is replaced with /bBasic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Skyward Ascent//b.

basicAttacks.name: Enlightened Mind - Skyward Ascent (Basic Attack)
basicAttacks.description:
While in the /bEnlightened Mind//b state and with /bQingming Sword Force//b, after the 2nd hit of /bBasic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Splitting Currents//b, press [BASIC] to activate:

Launches a swift rising attack, dealing Physical DMG and entering an airborne state. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

basicAttacks.name: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Maximum (Basic Attack)
basicAttacks.description:
After activating /bBasic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Annihilation//b, and with /bQingming Sword Force//b, press [BASIC] to activate:

Launches a wide sweeping slash forward, dealing massive Physical DMG. On hit, 1 point of /bQingming Sword Force//b is consumed. If struck by an enemy during the skill, triggers a block, negating that instance of DMG and increasing the skill's Interrupt Level.

After using this skill and with /bQingming Sword Force//b, press [EX] to consume 1 point of /bQingming Sword Force//b and launch a hit of /bEX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Soaring Light//b. This skill is automatically followed up with /bBasic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Skyward Ascent//b, and Ye Shunguang enters an airborne state. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

basicAttacks.name: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight (Basic Attack)
basicAttacks.description:
In the /bEnlightened Mind//b state, and while airborne, press [BASIC] to activate:

Launches up to two downward slashes in front, dealing Physical DMG. Ye Shunguang will not exit the /bEnlightened Mind//b state during this skill. Press [EX] or [DODGE] to follow up with /bBasic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Annihilation//b. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

basicAttacks.name: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Annihilation (Basic Attack)
basicAttacks.description:
After the 2nd hit of /bBasic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight//b, press [BASIC] to activate:

Performs a falling attack in front, entering a grounded state, and dealing Physical DMG. When launching this skill with 2 or more points of /bQingming Sword Force//b, Ye Shunguang will perform a downward falling strike across a large area in front instead, dealing massive Physical DMG. On hit, 2 points of /bQingming Sword Force//b are consumed, granting the /bCulmination//b effect.

After using this skill, if Ye Shunguang possesses /bQingming Sword Force//b, press [EX] to consume 1 point of /bQingming Sword Force//b and launch a hit of /bEX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Soaring Light//b, which can be quickly followed up with /bBasic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Maximum//b. Ye Shunguang will not exit the /bEnlightened Mind//b state during this skill. During this skill, if attacked by enemies, triggers a block, negating that instance of DMG. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

hits.name: DMG Multiplier With Qingming Sword Force
DMG Multiplier Without Qingming Sword Force

dashAttacks.name: Phantasm Dash (Dash Attack)
dashAttacks.description:
Press [BASIC] during a dodge to activate:

Slashes enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.

dodgeCounters.name: Swallow Strike (Dodge Counter)
dodgeCounters.description:
Press [BASIC] during a [COUNTER] to activate:

Leaps into the air and thrusts forward, dealing Physical DMG. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssists.name: Illuminating Darkness (Entry Skill)
quickAssists.description:
With 6 /bQingming Sword Force//b and while not in the /bEnlightened Mind//b state, hold [BASIC] to activate, or press [ASSIST] while in combat and switch on-field from off-field to activate:

Enters the /bEnlightened Mind//b state and activates /bEther Veil: Verdict//b. Deals Physical DMG to enemies in a large area in front. Activating this skill is considered as activating a /bQuick Assist//b. Enters the airborne state after using this skill. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssists.name: Support Guard (Quick Assist)
quickAssists.description:
When the active character is launched, press [ASSIST] to activate:

Leaps into the air and thrusts forward, dealing Physical DMG. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssists.name: Enlightened Mind - Tactical Support (Quick Assist)
quickAssists.description:
While in the /bEnlightened Mind//b state, when the active character is launched, press [ASSIST] to activate:

Launches a forward slash, dealing Physical DMG. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

assistFollowup.name: Cease Hostility (Assist Follow-Up)
assistFollowup.description:
Press [BASIC] after a [PERFECT] to activate:

Deals massive Physical DMG. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

assistFollowup.name: Enlightened Mind - Unification (Assist Follow-Up)
assistFollowup.description:
While in the /bEnlightened Mind//b state and after a [PERFECT], press [BASIC] to activate:

Deals massive Physical DMG. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

specialAttacks.name: Guiding Tides (Special Attack)
specialAttacks.description:
Press [SPECIAL] to activate:

If a dodge is available, 1 dodge chance is consumed, and the action is counted as activating a Dodge. If no dodge is available or a /bPerfect Dodge//b is not triggered, launches a quick sword energy attack that deals Physical DMG.

If a /bPerfect Dodge//b is triggered at this time, launches a flying sword attack, dealing Physical DMG, and immediately follow up with the 2nd hit of /bBasic Attack: Swiftedge//b. Character is briefly invulnerable during the skill.

specialAttacks.name: Enlightened Mind - Clean Exit (Special Attack)
specialAttacks.description:
While in the /bEnlightened Mind//b state and grounded, press [EX] to activate:

Performs a swift backstep slash, dealing Physical DMG. If a dodge is available, 1 dodge chance is consumed, and the action is counted as activating a Dodge. If a /bPerfect Dodge//b is triggered at this time, press [BASIC] to quickly activate /bEnlightened Mind - Sunderlight Maximum//b and enter /bVital View//b.

After this /bEnlightened Mind - Sunderlight Maximum//b activates, it can be immediately followed up with /bBasic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Skyward Ascent//b. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

exSkills.name: Gale Suppression (EX Special Attack)
exSkills.description:
With enough Energy, press [EX] to activate:

Launches a rushing slash and a flying sword attack at the enemy, dealing massive Physical DMG. Enemy attacks can be dodged during this skill. After this skill is used, gain 1 point of /bQingming Sword Force//b. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

exSkills.name: Enlightened Mind - Soaring Light (EX Special Attack)
exSkills.description:
In the /bEnlightened Mind//b state and with /bQingming Sword Force//b, hold [EX] to activate:

Performs quick consecutive slashes, dealing massive Physical DMG while rapidly consuming /bQingming Sword Force//b until none remains. The skill ends early if /bQingming Sword Force//b is insufficient or if [EX] is released. Ye Shunguang will not exit the /bEnlightened Mind//b state during this skill. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

hits.name: 1 Quingming Sword Force Consumed DMG Multiplier
6 Quingming Sword Force Consumed DMG Multiplier

exSkills.name: Enlightened Mind - Return to Dust (EX Special Attack)
exSkills.description:
In the /bEnlightened Mind//b state, press [ULTIMATE] or hold [EX] when all /bQingming Sword Force//b is expended to activate:

Deals massive Physical DMG to enemies in a large area. Ye Shunguang will not exit the /bEnlightened Mind//b state during this skill. After using this skill, /bEther Veil: Verdict//b is removed and the /bEnlightened Mind//b state ends. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

chainAttacks.name: Smite the Wicked (Chain Attack)
chainAttacks.description:
When a [CHAIN] is triggered, select the character to activate:

Unleashes a powerful slash at enemies ahead in a large area, dealing massive Physical DMG. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

chainAttacks.name: Enlightened Mind - Lure Thunder (Chain Attack)
chainAttacks.description:
While in the /bEnlightened Mind//b state, and when a [CHAIN] is triggered, select the character to activate:

Unleashes a powerful slash at enemies ahead in a large area, dealing massive Physical DMG. Ye Shunguang will not exit the /bEnlightened Mind//b state during this skill. Enter the airborne state after using this skill. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ultimate.name: Chasing Storms (Ultimate)
ultimate.description:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [ULTIMATE] to activate:

Summons a sword formation and enter the /bEnlightened Mind//b state, activating an /bEther Veil: Verdict//b while also gaining 6 /bQingming Sword Force//b. This skill deals massive Physical DMG.

Upon activating this skill, if Decibels are consumed, press [ULTIMATE] while in this /bEnlightened Mind//b state to launch an /bUltimate: Cleaving Heavens//b that doesn't consume Decibels. Enter the airborne state after using this skill. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ultimate.name: Cleaving Heavens (Ultimate)
ultimate.description:
After consuming Decibels to launch /bUltimate: Chasing Storms//b and while in the /bEnlightened Mind//b state, press [ULTIMATE] or hold [EX] when all /bQingming Sword Force//b is expended to activate:

Summons a massive blade, dealing massive Physical DMG to enemies. Ye Shunguang will not exit the /bEnlightened Mind//b state during this skill. After using this skill, the /bEnlightened Mind//b state ends, and /bEther Veil: Verdict//b is removed. This skill doesn't consume Decibels. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

mindscapeAbilities.name: Lantern Wish (Mindscape Cinema N°6)
mindscapeAbilities.description:
Upon entering the battlefield, gains 2 stacks of /bLantern Wish//b. When entering the /bEnlightened Mind//b state, gains 1 stack of /bLantern Wish//b, stacking up to 4 times.

With 3 stacks of /bLantern Wish//b, /bEX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Return to Dust//b is replaced with /bUltimate: Cleaving Heavens//b. When this /bUltimate: Cleaving Heavens//b is activated, it consumes 3 stacks of /bLantern Wish//b. The last hit of /bEnlightened Mind - Return to Dust//b and /bUltimate: Cleaving Heavens//b deal 1,500% of ATK as additional Physical DMG.
